race.comment: AUSTRALIA FOREVER (5) won in this company 3 starts back against her own sex, and her last couple of runs have been in a higher grade, including a tidy effort for sixth here 2 weeks ago when powering home late. She tries a middle distance for the first time, and can take it out. FLYING BRANT (1) had a tough trip and kept on coming at Halidon last time out on a day when nothing was running on. That effort stacks up nicely on this circuit and with the blinkers on for the first time, he is ready to show his best. Each way. TOTTORI (4) let down with an impressive finish to score at Strathalbyn nearly 4 weeks ago, and he gets another crack at weekend level. Some cut in the ground will suit him, and with conditions to suit, he is worth including. SOMEWHERE SOON (9) was reported to have not coped with a good track here 7-days ago, but will have Jason Holder back in the saddle to replace an apprentice this time, and she is well worth another chance. SYNTHESISE (7) is a last start winner.
